messages:
elaine (CEO): Quick all-hands Thurs 9:30 AM PT (20m). We'll cover: a small hosted data-retention update, Dedicated v1.2 launch highlights, a short incident recap, hiring notes, and Q&A. Please post Qs here.

rico (Product): Adding a short demo for v1.2. Need migration language for existing Dedicated customers  @ada can you draft?

ada (Comms): Drafted: 'Customers on active Dedicated commitments will gain access to v1.2 features during a staged rollout; billing changes, if any, will be communicated via account teams.' Will paste into slides.

sam (Eng): I'll cover the Mar incident: root cause = autoscaler misconfig + missing canary gate. Fixes: config lint + automated rollback. Preparing a 1-slide summary.

mai (People Ops): Hiring update: 6 new reqs, 2 hires closed. Also a referral-bonus bump to announce. Need 20s in People block.

ops-bot: Reminder: upload slides via /allhands-slides by EOD Wed. Recording will be posted to #all-hands-recordings.

elaine (CEO): Collection prompt: what's the one question your customers want answered? I'll start: 'Will hosted retention default change for free-tier customers?'

rico (Product): Product asks: will Optimize suggestions be opt-in? We'll state 'opt-in by default' unless account opts in.

ada (Comms): Slides uploaded: https://drive.google.com/slide/d/1ExamplePulseDraft  please review and :eyes: react when done.

sam (Eng): Uploaded p50/p95 numbers for the demo region, and the incident GIF. Small chart tweak requested on slide 5.

elaine (CEO): Post-meeting plan: publish slides + recording + 5 takeaways in #all-hands-summary within 24h. Proposed takeaways: 1) retention policy update, 2) v1.2 rollout & migration help, 3) incident mitigations, 4) hiring + referral bump, 5) EU private-control-plane pilot timeline. Owners will be assigned in the follow-up doc.

mai (People Ops): I'll coordinate customer-facing retention wording with Legal and Comms; deliverable by EOD Wed.

ops-bot: Calendar invite updated. Recording placeholder: https://redwood.zoom/rec/placeholder123.

elaine (CEO): Thanks everyone. If you can't attend, drop Qs here and we'll cover them in the Q&A. Slides + transcript will be posted.
